id.description: Immutable human-readable Source Document ID following docs/SOURCE_REFERENCE.md; this provenance identifier is intentionally not a UUID.

schema_version.description: Version of the JSON Schema contract used to validate this record; it changes only through documented repository migrations.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this repository record was first created; this is audit metadata, not the real-world entity's founding or start date.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest repository record change; it must be updated whenever a structured value or its provenance changes.

source_ids.description: Set containing this document's own Source Document ID and, when applicable, IDs of antecedent documents from which it was reproduced or revised.

confidence_score.description: Evidence-strength score from 1 (unverified or speculative) to 5 (verified SEC filing), assigned under ASSUMPTIONS.md.

status.description: Current lifecycle classification for the represented entity or record; unknown is used when available evidence does not establish a state.

notes.description: Optional analyst clarification about scope, ambiguity, estimation, or lifecycle context; null means no clarification is recorded and notes never replace structured provenance.

title.description: Observed document title or a precise descriptive title when the source provides none.

source_type.description: Allowed classification of the document's provenance and publication channel.

publisher.description: Observed legal entity, agency, utility, news organization, or counterparty that issued the document.

published_date.description: Observed ISO 8601 publication or filing date stated by the source.

retrieved_at.description: UTC date-time when the document or its metadata was retrieved for repository use.

canonical_url.description: Optional absolute URI for the authoritative online document; null when unavailable or access is exclusively offline.

archive_path.description: Optional repository-relative or approved external archive locator for a permitted immutable copy; null when no copy may be retained.

sha256.description: Optional hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the archived document bytes for integrity verification; null when no archived copy exists.

locator.description: Optional page, section, exhibit, table, paragraph, or timestamp locating the supporting passage; null when the document as a whole is cited.
